run_plot_results: run the script to generate bar plots and evolution plots from PyTorch result files
generate_barplot: generate bar plots showing accuracy, backward transfer, and forward transfer for continual learning models
generate_evoplot: generate evolution line plots showing accuracy over tasks for each model and dataset
load_torch_results: load PyTorch .pt result files using glob pattern matching and torch.load
configure_matplotlib: configure matplotlib with DejaVu Serif font and Agg backend for non-interactive plotting
